diagram:
flowchart TD
  SCHED["⏰ Scheduler 9:30AM"] --> HOLD["📊 Fetch RH Holdings"]
  HOLD --> SCREEN["🔍 FD screen_stocks"]
  SCREEN --> BUCK["🪣 Dual Bucket\nMomentum + Value"]
  BUCK --> SCORE["📈 Score Calculator"]
  PROFILE["⚖️ Risk Profile"] --> SCORE
  SCORE --> GATE{"Score >= Threshold?"}
  GATE -->|Yes| SIG["✍️ Write agent_signal"]
  GATE -->|No| SKIP["⏭️ Skip Symbol"]
  SIG --> PAPER["💼 PaperTrader"]
  PAPER --> EXIT["🎯 Set price_target + stop_loss"]
  EXIT --> MON["👁️ Position Monitor 4:15PM"]
  MON --> TRAIL["📐 Trailing Stop Update"]
  TRAIL --> CLOSE{"Stop or Target Hit?"}
  CLOSE -->|Yes| CLOSE_POS["🔒 Close Position"]
  CLOSE -->|No| HOLD_POS["⏳ Hold"]
  CLOSE_POS --> LEARN["🎓 LearnerAgent Sunday"]

SCHED.label: Scheduler 9:30AM
SCHED.description: Claude Code scheduled task fires weekdays at 9:30 AM ET, calls /api/agents/research/cron
SCHED.addReason: Entry point — market opens at 9:30, research runs immediately after
SCHED.changeReason: Moved from pg_cron (broken {{APP_URL}} placeholder) to Claude Code scheduled task

HOLD.label: Fetch RH Holdings
HOLD.description: Pulls current Robinhood positions from account 965848641 (read-only). Holdings get SELL signal priority.
HOLD.addReason: Must check existing positions first. Can't recommend BUY on something already owned.

SCREEN.label: FD screen_stocks Screener
SCREEN.description: Uses FinancialDatasets screen_stocks API for fundamentals screening. Returns 20-50 candidates per run.
SCREEN.addReason: Robinhood run_scan too shallow — only price/volume. FD gives P/E, revenue growth, FCF yield.

BUCK.label: Dual Bucket
BUCK.description: Momentum bucket (RSI>60, price>50MA) and Value bucket (P/E<sector, high FCF). Both always run — no explicit regime detection.
BUCK.addReason: Single strategy fails in different market regimes. Dual bucket adapts via scoring rather than brittle regime switches.

SCORE.label: Score Calculator
SCORE.description: Weighted 5-factor score: fundamental, technical, sentiment, macro, insider. Score 0-100. Risk profile shifts weights.
SCORE.addReason: Single number to rank and filter candidates.
SCORE.changeReason: Risk profile weights override defaults: Conservative +10% fundamental, Aggressive +10% technical+sentiment

PROFILE.label: Risk Profile
PROFILE.description: Conservative (score≥72, 7% position, -5% stop, +12% target), Balanced (score≥60, 10%, -7%, +20%), Aggressive (score≥52, 15%, -10%, +35%).
PROFILE.addReason: Agent had no awareness of user risk tolerance. Same stock screened same way regardless of preference.

GATE.label: Score Threshold Gate
GATE.description: Filters signals below minimum score. Threshold from risk_profile config (52-72). Previously hardcoded 60.
GATE.addReason: Gate prevents low-conviction signals from becoming trades.
GATE.changeReason: Now reads strategy_config.score_threshold set by risk profile

SIG.label: Write agent_signal
SIG.description: Writes to Supabase agent_signals: symbol, direction, analyst_score, rationale, price_target, agent_label.
SIG.addReason: Signals must persist for PaperTrader and LearnerAgent.
SIG.changeReason: Now also writes price_target from risk profile target_pct

PAPER.label: PaperTrader
PAPER.description: Fills paper position at current price. Sizes using position_size_pct from risk profile (7-15% of NAV).
PAPER.addReason: Test signals without real money. Builds track record before real trading gate opens.
PAPER.changeReason: Position size reads from risk_profile.position_size_pct (was hardcoded 10%)

EXIT.label: Set price_target + stop_loss
EXIT.description: price_target from signal or fill × (1 + target_pct/100). stop_loss = fill × (1 - stop_loss_pct/100). highest_price = fill.
EXIT.addReason: Previously positions only closed after 7 days. Now exit by target (WIN) or stop (LOSS) with trailing stop.

MON.label: Position Monitor
MON.description: Runs 4:15 PM daily. Fetches current prices, updates highest_price, computes trailing stop, checks exit.
MON.addReason: Daily price-based exit checks without LLM cost.

TRAIL.label: Trailing Stop Update
TRAIL.description: trailing_stop = max(original_stop, highest_price × 0.93). Never moves down. Locks in gains.
TRAIL.addReason: Fixed stop loses all gains if stock runs then reverses.

CLOSE.label: Stop/Target Check
CLOSE.description: price <= trailing_stop → LOSS. price >= price_target → WIN. Otherwise hold.
CLOSE.addReason: Binary exit decision. No LLM needed.

CLOSE_POS.label: Close Position
CLOSE_POS.description: Sets closed_at, exit_price, realized_pnl, outcome, exit_reason. Returns cash to portfolio.
CLOSE_POS.addReason: Clean close record for LearnerAgent analysis.

HOLD_POS.label: Hold
HOLD_POS.description: No action — position continues. Checked again at 4:15 PM tomorrow.

SKIP.label: Skip Symbol
SKIP.description: Symbol below threshold. No signal, no trade.
SKIP.addReason: Most screened symbols not worth trading.

LEARN.label: LearnerAgent
LEARN.description: Sundays 8 PM. Analyzes closed trades, win rate vs SPY. Phase 0: read-only. Phase 1: weight mutation after 10 trades.
LEARN.addReason: Without feedback loop, same bad signals repeat.

history.label: Scheduler
history.reason: Moved to Claude Code scheduled task
